description: AlphaFold v6 per-domain confidence for LRIT2 and structural context of the isoform 2 insertion point D297
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, statistics
r=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-A6NDA9-F1-model_v6.pdb",
               headers={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0"},timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
pdb=r.text
ca={}; allatoms={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        rn=int(l[22:26]); nm=l[12:16].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]); b=float(l[60:66])
        allatoms.setdefault(rn,[]).append((nm,xyz))
        if nm=="CA": ca[rn]=(l[17:20].strip(),xyz,b)
res=sorted(ca); print("modelled residues:",len(res), res[0],"-",res[-1])

regions=[("signal peptide",1,19),("LRRNT",23,54),("LRR1",80,103),("LRR2",104,125),("LRR3",128,149),
         ("LRR4",152,173),("LRRCT",200,252),("Ig-like",253,341),("FN3",361,451),("TM helix",466,486),
         ("disordered C-term",508,550)]
print("\n%-22s %10s %7s"%("region","meanpLDDT","min"))
for nm,a,b in regions+[("insert site 292-302",292,302)]:
    v=np.array([ca[i][2] for i in range(a,b+1) if i in ca]); print("%-22s %10.1f %7.1f"%(nm,v.mean(),v.min()))

def atom(rn,nm):
    for n,x in allatoms[rn]:
        if n==nm: return x
d=np.linalg.norm(atom(274,"SG")-atom(327,"SG"))
print("\nC274 SG - C327 SG distance: %.2f A (canonical Ig disulfide ~2.05)"%d)
p297=ca[297][1]; mid=(atom(274,"SG")+atom(327,"SG"))/2
igres=[i for i in range(253,342) if i in ca]; igc=np.mean([ca[i][1] for i in igres],axis=0)
print("D297 CA -> disulfide midpoint: %.1f A"%np.linalg.norm(p297-mid))
print("D297 CA -> Ig centroid: %.1f A"%np.linalg.norm(p297-igc))
rad=np.mean([np.linalg.norm(ca[i][1]-igc) for i in igres]); print("mean Ig CA radius: %.1f A"%rad)
cnt={i:sum(1 for k in ca if k!=i and np.linalg.norm(ca[k][1]-ca[i][1])<10) for i in igres}
pct=100*sum(1 for v in cnt.values() if v<cnt[297])/len(cnt)
print("CA neighbours within 10A: Ig mean %.1f, D297=%d -> burial percentile %.0f%% (low = surface-exposed)"%(statistics.mean(cnt.values()),cnt[297],pct))
near=sorted(i for i in ca if abs(i-297)>4 and np.linalg.norm(ca[i][1]-p297)<12)
print("neighbours within 12A (|i-297|>4):",near)
print("all inside Ig 253-341?", all(253<=i<=341 for i in near))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.4))
x=np.array(res); y=np.array([ca[i][2] for i in res])
ax.plot(x,y,lw=1.1,color="#2b2b2b"); ax.axhline(70,ls="--",lw=0.8,color="grey")
cols=plt.cm.tab20(np.linspace(0,1,len(regions)))
for (nm,a,b),c in zip(regions,cols):
    ax.axvspan(a,b,alpha=0.3,color=c)
    ax.text((a+b)/2,104,nm,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7.5,rotation=90)
ax.axvline(297,color="crimson",lw=2)
ax.annotate("isoform 2: +GLLGGKHLTP\nafter D297",xy=(297,ca[297][2]),xytext=(355,25),
            color="crimson",fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="crimson"))
ax.set_xlabel("residue (A6NDA9-1 numbering)"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_ylim(0,128); ax.set_xlim(1,550)
ax.set_title("LRIT2 AlphaFold v6 confidence: both isoforms keep every annotated domain; isoform 2 inserts 10 residues inside the Ig-like domain")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
